newsitem.title: USA: Tencor sees signs of market bottom.
newsitem.headline: Tencor sees signs of market bottom.

text.p: The market for Tencor Instruments' semiconductor measurement equipment may have touched bottom in the last quarter, Jon Tompkins, the company's chairman and chief executive, said on Tuesday.

"The good news here is that we've seen rescheduling and de-booking drop dramatically," Tompkins said, referring to the delays and cancellations that hit the industry in the second half of 1996. "There's a lot less turmoil out there."
Bookings actually rose 12 percent in the fourth quarter from the third, Tompkins told investors in a presentation at the Robertson Stephens technology conference in San Francisco.
